EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AMENDED BY LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: 3/ඉ/අƮපƮ/2/1. Reference No. of the Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms: 4-3/9/2013/WS/510.
I hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that The Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose:
Description of the land to be acquired:

The allotment of land called “Ganekanda Mukalana” in total extent of about 0.1012 Hectares, depicted as Lot No. 332 in Final Village Plan No. 463, Suppliment No. 32, Sheet No. 28, dated on 14.12.2016, surveyed and prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the village of Alawwa, in Alawwa/North Division Grama Niladhari Division of in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Alawwa in Kurunegala District, North Western Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot No. 332 Name of the Land: Ganekanda Mukalana; Extent of the Land: 0.1012 Hectare.
Boundaries: North: Lot Nos. 234 and 233; East: Lot Nos. 276 and 277; South: Lot No. 333; West: Lot No. 333.
Names and Address of the claimants: 1. Mrs. Mallikage Seetha Ramani, Reeloluwa, Giriulla.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretary’s Office, at Alawwa on the 10 day of October 2017 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 16 day of October 2017, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
P. SUSANTHA JAYATHILAKE,, Divisional Secretary, Alawwa.
Divisional Secretariat, Alawwa, 20th September, 2017. 10-258

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
Land Ministry Ref. No. J/63/64/E/296.
My Ref. No.: EP/LD/1/02/12.

I, hereby in form you that the Section for section 7 under the Land Acquisition Act is hereby reissued as no claimants had been presented for the relevant Land Acquisition investigation that was scheduled to be held at 10 p.m. On 11th February in 1967 at the Divisional Secretariat, Elpitiya for the investigations under Sec 09, where as the Gazette Notification for the Sec. 07 had been published on 23rd December in 1966.
The notice is hereby given under the sub Section (01) in the Section 07 of the Land Acquisition Act as the Government intends to acquire the below mentioned land for a public purpose.
The Description of the land to be acquired:
Acquiring land to the state on behalf of the G/Indipalegoda Maha Vidyalaya.

The second supplement of the bearing No. 595 of the ultimate map of the village Indipalegoda Village, Indipalegoda Grama Niladhari Division, No. 30B of the Elpitiya Divisional Secretariat Division, Bentota Walallawita Korale - East in Galle District.
01. Lot No. 269 Name of the Land: Stream (Ela); Description: Stream; Extent : 0 Acres 0 Roods 02.5 Perches.
02. Lot No. 270 Name of the Land: Dikhena Pollawwa Pansala Addara Waththa; Description: The land consisted of nearly 30 year old 40 Rubber trees; Extent : 0 Acres 3 Roods 27.5 Perches.
03. Lot No. 271 Name of the Land: Dikhena Pollawwa Pansala Addara Waththa; Description: The land consisted of nearly 30 year old 40 Rubber trees; Extent : 0 Acres 3 Roods 01.0 Perches.

06. Lot No. 274 Name of the Land: Dikhena Pollawwa Millagahahena Waththa; Description: The land consisted of 50 year old 31 Number of Rubber trees; Extent : 0 Acre 2 Roods 18.0 Perches.

08. Lot No. 276 Name of the Land: Millagahahena Waththa Millagaha Waththa Katiya; Description: The permanent house roofing with asbestos and one year old 10 Coconut trees; Extent : 1 Acre 0 Rood 0 Perche.

The all claimants and people who have ownership or other relation to the aforementioned land themselves or the people who are authorized by their documents should be appeared before me at 10.00 a.m. on 28th November in 2017, at the Divisional Secretariat, Elpitiya.

Further, the nature of their ownership related to the mentioned land, details on the facts for claiming compensation regarding the acquiring that land, the amount of compensation and the way it is calculated shall be received to me by duly completed copies prior to the 14th November 2017.
S. K. W. SISIRA KUMARA, Divisional Secretary, Elpitiya.
At the Divisional Secretariat, Elpitiya, 31st August, 2017. 10-260
